evidence.quote: Anthropic has introduced Claude Science , a new AI workbench for scientists that integrates research tools, produces auditable artifacts, and connects to specialized life sciences models and workflows from NVIDIA .
evidence.one_line: Anthropic introduced Claude Science, a scientific AI workbench that connects to NVIDIA life sciences models and workflows (announced around June 30, 2026).
evidence.speaker: Anthropic

evidence.quote: The beta release, announced June 30, gives Claude Pro, Max, Team, and Enterprise users access to an application designed to help researchers work across literature review, data analysis, figure generation, manuscript refinement, and computational workflows.
evidence.one_line: Claude Science beta, announced June 30, is available to Claude Pro, Max, Team and Enterprise users on macOS and Linux.
evidence.speaker: Anthropic

evidence.quote: NVIDIA's role comes through its BioNeMo Agent Toolkit , which the chipmaker announced June 23.
evidence.one_line: NVIDIA announced its BioNeMo Agent Toolkit on June 23, 2026.
evidence.speaker: NVIDIA

evidence.quote: Anthropic said Claude Science uses BioNeMo Agent Toolkit skills to connect to life sciences models and libraries in BioNeMo, including Evo 2, Boltz-2, and OpenFold3.
evidence.one_line: Anthropic said Claude Science uses BioNeMo Agent Toolkit skills to connect to Evo 2, Boltz-2 and OpenFold3 models.
evidence.speaker: Anthropic

evidence.quote: Microsoft has unveiled Frontier Company, making a $2.5 billion bet that the next competitive battleground in artificial intelligence will not be foundation models, but helping enterprises put those models to work.
evidence.one_line: Microsoft unveiled Frontier Company with a $2.5 billion bet on enterprise AI deployment.
evidence.speaker: Microsoft
